title: Remote impact job picks for 22 October 2026
introduction: Eight employer-source-checked roles in climate, software and early-career impact work. Compare hiring locations and experience before applying.

senior-software-engineer-energyhub-3.title: Senior Software Engineer
senior-software-engineer-energyhub-3.location_summary: Remote United States. Eligible states only. No new employment sponsorship.
senior-software-engineer-energyhub-3.experience_summary: 7+ years professional software engineering. React, Java, TypeScript.
senior-software-engineer-energyhub-3.editorial_note: Build grid-flexibility software. Eligible US states only. No new employment sponsorship.

customer-success-associate-voltus-1.title: Customer Success Associate
customer-success-associate-voltus-1.location_summary: Remote US or Canada. Must have home-location work authorization. No visa sponsorship or transfers.
customer-success-associate-voltus-1.experience_summary: 2+ years customer-facing customer success, onboarding, account or project management.
customer-success-associate-voltus-1.pay_summary: USD 70,000 to 74,000 base annually, plus 10% annual bonus and equity.
customer-success-associate-voltus-1.editorial_note: Help customers participate in energy demand-response programmes. Requires prior customer-facing experience.

data-scientist-syso.title: Data Scientist
data-scientist-syso.location_summary: Employer labels Boston, MA and Remote. Hiring-country eligibility and work authorization are not specified in the visible description.
data-scientist-syso.experience_summary: Early-career through senior considered. Technical degree, Python and relevant professional experience.
data-scientist-syso.pay_summary: No numerical salary published on employer page.
data-scientist-syso.editorial_note: Renewable-energy and storage forecasting. Hiring-country eligibility needs confirmation.

software-engineer-early-career-construct.title: Software Engineer (Early Career)
software-engineer-early-career-construct.location_summary: Remote United States. Must be US-based with work authorization without current or future sponsorship. Flexible within US time zones.
software-engineer-early-career-construct.experience_summary: Early-career. Degree or equivalent practical experience and at least one reviewed engineering project beyond coursework, including internship, freelance or sustained open source.
software-engineer-early-career-construct.editorial_note: Mentored education-software work. A project beyond coursework is required.

recruitment-associate-impact-ops.title: Recruitment Associate
recruitment-associate-impact-ops.location_summary: Remote-first. US East or West Coast preferred. Employer says exceptional candidates elsewhere may be considered. Country eligibility is not globally guaranteed.
recruitment-associate-impact-ops.experience_summary: 1 to 3 years recruitment, talent acquisition or related experience.
recruitment-associate-impact-ops.pay_summary: USD 60,000 to 80,000 starting salary, location and experience dependent.
recruitment-associate-impact-ops.editorial_note: Recruitment for impact organisations. Deadline 31 October 2026; rolling review may close earlier.

human-resources-associate-centre-for-eff.title: Human Resources Associate
human-resources-associate-centre-for-eff.location_summary: Employer labels Remote - Global. Prefers US Pacific Time to GMT. Likely 2 to 3 trips per year. Local employment feasibility still must be checked.
human-resources-associate-centre-for-eff.experience_summary: 2+ years operations, HR operations, people operations or similar.
human-resources-associate-centre-for-eff.pay_summary: US base USD 79,200 to 90,000 plus 10% unconditional 401k contribution. Other locations adjusted to local employment and benefit costs.
human-resources-associate-centre-for-eff.editorial_note: People operations for an impact organisation. Deadline 30 October 2026. Prior experience and travel required.

full-stack-software-engineer-cfs-platfor.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (CFS Platform)
full-stack-software-engineer-cfs-platfor.location_summary: US/Canada compensation scope, United States department. Do not imply worldwide eligibility. Confirm location with employer.
full-stack-software-engineer-cfs-platfor.experience_summary: Solid production web application experience, TypeScript and React. First dedicated platform engineer, independent ownership. Not presented as junior.
full-stack-software-engineer-cfs-platfor.pay_summary: USD 110,000 to 145,000 US/Canada range, commensurate with experience, plus equity.
full-stack-software-engineer-cfs-platfor.editorial_note: Build climate-funding software. Independent platform ownership; not presented as a junior role.

staff-data-engineer-overstory-1.title: Staff Data Engineer
staff-data-engineer-overstory-1.location_summary: Remote in the United States, Canada, Denmark, France, Ireland, Netherlands, Portugal, Sweden, Switzerland or United Kingdom. Employer lists time zones in Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST). This is not Europe-wide or worldwide eligibility.
staff-data-engineer-overstory-1.experience_summary: 10+ years designing and building production-grade data pipelines and systems. Senior staff role; Python, Google Cloud and production data orchestration.
staff-data-engineer-overstory-1.pay_summary: No numerical salary published on the current employer overview. Compensation varies by location.
staff-data-engineer-overstory-1.editorial_note: Lead satellite-based vegetation data systems for wildfire risk reduction and grid resilience. The employer lists named UK and European hiring locations.

sections.title: Climate and energy
sections.description: Five roles in grid flexibility, customer success, data science, climate-funding software and wildfire-risk data systems.

sections.title: Software and data for impact
sections.description: These roles support energy, education and climate work. They are not all academic research-software positions.

sections.title: Early-career routes with clear requirements
sections.description: CDI explicitly offers an early-career engineering role. Impact Ops requires 1 to 3 years; CEA requires 2+ years. None is verified as a worldwide, no-experience job.
